entities.summary: The International Union of Muslim Scholars is an independent international body of Islamic theologians, currently headed by Ali al-Qaradaghi since 2022. Founded in 2004, with its headquarters split between Qatar and Dublin, the largely Sunni group works to centralize international Islamic jurisprudence.
